## Notes on hosting tools here

GitHub Pages serves static files only, so there is no server-side Python or R.
Two routes:

**Runs in the browser, hosted here.** Embed directly in a `.qmd` page.

- Observable JS: put `{ojs}` cells straight into the page
- Maps: Leaflet or MapLibre via a plain `<script>` block
- Python in the browser: Pyodide, works well up to moderate data sizes
- A trained model: export to ONNX or TensorFlow.js and run inference client-side

**Needs a server, hosted elsewhere and embedded.** Free tiers all work fine:

- Hugging Face Spaces (Gradio or Streamlit, good for model demos)
- Streamlit Community Cloud
- shinyapps.io (Shiny for R or Python)

Embed with an iframe:

``` html
<iframe src="https://YOUR-SPACE.hf.space"
        width="100%" height="700" frameborder="0"></iframe>
```

Keep tool code in its own repository rather than in this one. This site stays
fast to build, and each tool keeps its own dependencies.
